stem: A pharmacist assigns duties to a technician trainee. Select all supported principles.

choices.text: The trainee may perform only duties allowed for that category under pharmacist supervision.
The trainee may independently counsel patients.
Professional judgment functions remain with the pharmacist.
The trainee may resolve a DUR alert without pharmacist review.
Registration converts the trainee into a pharmacist intern.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. Pharmacy technicians and trainees may perform only duties allowed by 247 CMR 8 under pharmacist supervision; judgmental pharmacist functions may not be delegated.

choice_analysis.A: The proposition 'The trainee may perform only duties allowed for that category under pharmacist supervision.' is supported by Massachusetts pharmacy technician scope and pharmacist responsibility: Pharmacy technicians and trainees may perform only duties allowed by 247 CMR 8 under pharmacist supervision; judgmental pharmacist functions may not be delegated.
choice_analysis.B: This statement imports Schedule II prescriptions may not be refilled without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.C: The proposition 'Professional judgment functions remain with the pharmacist.' is supported by Massachusetts pharmacy technician scope and pharmacist responsibility: Pharmacy technicians and trainees may perform only duties allowed by 247 CMR 8 under pharmacist supervision; judgmental pharmacist functions may not be delegated.
choice_analysis.D: This statement imports Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This statement imports Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
